picks.name: Anthony Naples
picks.bio: Already in your library. "BBT / Seven" (September 24, 2026, ANS) is a two-track single -- 'BBT' rides optimistic chords and a naive vocal over a thrumming bassline, while 'Seven' opens up into widescreen pads with a proggy undertow.
picks.why_listen: A tight, self-released two-tracker from a dependable house producer -- 'BBT' has an immediate, hooky bounce that works well as a set opener or riser.

picks.name: Arnaud Le Texier
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Children Of Tomorrow Records (already followed).
picks.bio: "Ripple EP" (September 18, 2026, Children Of Tomorrow Records) is a four-track release -- Residue, Howdy, Ripple, Granite -- from the label's own co-founder, delivering timeless, driving techno.
picks.why_listen: Straightforward, well-built techno from a label veteran -- solid, no-frills tools for a driving stretch of a set.
